description: This file defines the CosmosClusteringProviderBuilder class which implements provider configuration logic for Orleans clustering and gateway list using Azure Cosmos DB as storage, including registration attributes and configuration methods for silo and client builders.

classes.name: CosmosClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: Implements provider building logic for Cosmos DB clustering in Orleans, providing configuration methods for both silo and client builders.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder with Cosmos clustering options, setting parameters like database name, container name, throughput, resource creation flag, and Cosmos client connection details.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans client builder with Cosmos gateway list provider options, including database name, container name, throughput, resource creation flag, and Cosmos client connection details.
